zh: (1925-64) a US writer of novels and short stories which combine violence and comedy and are set in the South. Her novels were Wise Blood (1952) and The Violent Bear It Away (1960) and her collections of short stories include A Good Man Is Hard to Find (1955).
en: (1925-64) a US writer of novels and short stories which combine violence and comedy and are set in the South. Her novels were Wise Blood (1952) and The Violent Bear It Away (1960) and her collections of short stories include A Good Man Is Hard to Find (1955).

zh: （附于某物的）片状下垂物，封盖，口盖，袋盖
公众不同意；群众愤怒；大众批评
en: a flat piece of paper, cloth, metal, etc. that is attached to something along one side and that hangs down or covers an opening
ex: the flap of an envelope
信封的封盖

en: a thick soft biscuit made from oats, butter, sugar and syrup

zh: （20 世纪 20 年代不受传统拘束的）新潮女郎
en: a fashionable young woman in the 1920s who was interested in modern ideas and was determined to enjoy herself

zh: （短暂）烧旺；（摇曳着）燃烧；（火光）闪耀
en: to burn brightly, but usually for only a short time or not steadily
ex: The match flared and went out.
火柴闪亮了一下就熄了。

en: to suddenly start burning more brightly
ex: He put more logs on the fire and watched it flare up again.
他把更多的原木放在火上，看着它再次燃烧起来。

zh: 骤燃；突然燃起更大的火焰
en: a sudden expression of angry or violent feeling
ex: a flare-up of tension between the two sides
双方剑拔弩张

en: wider at the bottom edge than at the top
ex: a flared skirt
喇叭裙

zh: an area that is brightly lit in order for a plane to take off and land
en: an area that is brightly lit in order for a plane to take off and land
a sudden bright light that shines for a moment and then disappears
ex: a flash of lightning
一道闪电

en: to show something to other people in order to impress them
ex: He's always flashing his money around.
他总是在炫耀他的金钱。

en: if your mind flashes back to something, you remember something that happened in the past
ex: Her thoughts flashed back to their wedding day.
她回忆起他们婚礼那一天的情景。

en: to go very quickly
ex: The morning has just flashed by.
这个上午转眼就过去了。

en: a card with a word or picture on it, used by teachers during lessons
ex: This study app has flash cards and word games that children love.
这款学习应用程序具有儿童喜爱的闪存卡和文字游戏。

en: a small memory device that can be used to store data from a computer or digital camera and to move it from one device to another
ex: Insert the flash drive into the USB port.
将闪存驱动器插入USB端口。
